step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram and transcript depict Axileon's hybrid CI/CD platform. Developers submit merge requests to an on-premises GitLab server. On-premises server infrastructure includes GitLab, Jenkins, and a Windows/Linux/macOS server farm. To solve capacity bottlenecks during peak testing times, GitLab and Jenkins use plugins to invoke the Amazon EC2 API across a secure Site-to-Site VPN connection into an Amazon VPC. The EC2 API provisions temporary EC2 Spot Instances to run test jobs dynamically, reducing costs by up to 62% without requiring data retention.
